result.note: Tests the Nepali destination of India's first direct container freight train into Nepal, a connectivity first with a geography angle.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India ran its first direct container freight train into Nepal from Kolkata Port. Which Nepali city did the train reach?
questions.explain: The train ran from Kolkata Port to Biratnagar on 29 July 2026. It reached Biratnagar without any transshipment of cargo at the India–Nepal border.
questions.source: India ran its first direct container freight train into Nepal, reaching Biratnagar from Kolkata Port without transshipment at the border.
